simple.meaning: מֶדֶו (medev) is a Hebrew word meaning “properly, extent , i.e. measure ; by implication, a dress (as measured).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מֶדֶו (H4063) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 2 Samuel 10:4, with occurrences in 2 Samuel, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מֶדֶו (H4063) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מֶדֶו (H4063) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מֶדֶו (medev) / H4063 is traced through 2 Samuel 10:4, 1 Chronicles 19:4 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
